kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-saas-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --workspace-id 'ws-*****' --service-type drama --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSaasService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The workspace of the SaaS service
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:
memroy
drama
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription

If you do not specify this parameter, a free service is created by default.
In subscription mode, you can get a discount if you purchase a subscription with a duration of one year or longer. Select a billing method as needed
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型，取值如下：

Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：包年包月

如果不填，则会默认创建Free免费类型的。
包年包月计费模式下，一次性购买一年及以上时长时会有一定优惠，建议您按需选择计费类型
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the purchased resource. Valid values:
If Period is set to Month, valid values are 1 to 11.
If Period is set to Year, valid values are 1 to 3.

This parameter is required when you create a subscription service
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。取值如下：
当Period为Month时，取值为1~11。
当Period为Year时，取值为1~3。

创建包年包月计费类型的实例时必须传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:
Month: month
Year: year

This parameter is required when you create a subscription service
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值如下：
Month：月
Year：年

创建包年包月计费类型的实例时必须传入该参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The compute resources of the SaaS service
parameters.name: cu
